How the job forecast becomes a daily, self-updating system

Long image

A

Answer

The role forecast is not on the automatic path today. Only skills refresh daily. Role demand, backtest and forecast change only when someone runs them by hand, so the plan adds a daily role refresh in Phase 1.

  1. Today the daily job rebuilds skills only, from the newest HN thread.
  2. Each daily run writes to a new snapshot. latest.json moves only when the whole run succeeds, so a failed fetch keeps the last good forecast.
  3. Phase 1 alone fixes the main gap. Each later phase ships alone and adds scenarios, a ledger of past forecasts, or re-planning.

Applies toPlan dated 29 Oct 2026draft, nothing built, not committed

1

What runs today, and what does not?

Role forecast is NOT on the automatic path

The daily scheduler refreshes skills only. The role files are built by hand from the raw HN folder on a laptop.

2

What changes in the daily run?

Each node carries its status in its label: UNCHANGED is existing and untouched, CHANGED is existing but modified, and NEW is added. Solid arrows are the daily path. Dashed arrows are side branches with no weight in the forecast yet.

Diagram structure
  • NEW: daily scheduler sched
  • CHANGED: refresh newest HN thread hnf
  • CHANGED: demand, this month only dem
  • NEW: partial-month nowcast now
  • CHANGED: backtest, q re-fit bt
  • CHANGED: forecast, Moderate and Fast fc
  • CHANGED: snapshot, latest.json on success store
  • CHANGED: API reads live snapshot api
  • NEW: forecast_ledger.csv led
  • CHANGED: date, posts so far, changes app
  • NEW: re-plan if top 3 moved rp
  • NEW: Malaysia evidence panel, from my_jobs.py mev
  • UNCHANGED: trendsignal, 15 min ts
  • NEW: news momentum feature mlf
  • NEW: persona panel, logged, evidence only per
  • NEW: discover.py title phrases dsc
  • NEW: human review, then roles.json rev
  • api → app
  • app → rp
  • bt → fc
  • dem → now
  • dsc → rev
  • fc → store
  • hnf → dem
  • mev → app
  • mlf → fc
  • now → bt
  • sched → hnf
  • store → api
  • store → led
  • ts → mlf

Band and label thresholds use hysteresis: a re-plan alert fires only if the change holds for two runs or crosses a label.

3

What happens in one daily run, and when it fails?

Diagram structure
  • Daily scheduler sch
  • refresh.py ref
  • HN Algolia API hn
  • Role engine eng
  • Store st
  • API and app ap
  • sch → ref · run daily job
  • ref → hn · fetch newest thread
  • hn → ref · thread JSON
  • ref → eng · this month demand, nowcast, backtest
  • eng → ref · Moderate and Fast forecast
  • ref → st · write snapshot to runtime folder
  • st → ap · switch latest.json
  • hn → ref · timeout or rate limit
  • ref → st · discard run, write nothing
  • st → ap · latest.json stays on last good snapshot
  • ref → sch · retry at next daily run

If any step fails, latest.json keeps the last good snapshot. The app shows that snapshot with its date, so a stale forecast is visible rather than silent.

Which files change, and in which phase?

FileChangePhase
engine/refresh.pyAfter the thread is fetched, recompute role demand for that month, then run role backtest and role forecast into the runtime folderP1
engine/store.py, engine/scheduled.pyAdd role_demand_monthly.csv, role_backtest.json, role_forecast.json and forecast_ledger.csv to the snapshotP1
API route /api/roles/forecastRead from live.start_dir() instead of committed data/P1
frontend/screens-explore.jsShow fetched date, posts so far, and what changedP1, P3
engine/forecast.pyNowcast blend for the partial month, used by skills and rolesP2
engine/backtest.pyPartial-month cut backtest at day 3, 7 and 14P2
engine/ledger.py and forecast_ledger.csv (new)Append one row per role per run, score monthlyP3
engine/role_forecast.pyFast scenario per roleP4
engine/roles.pyfuture_score continuous from forecast change, per scenario; update tests/test_roles.pyP4
backend/signals/trendsignal/scheduler.pyAdd daily refresh and my_jobs jobsP1, P5
engine/ml_forecast.pyNews momentum feature, weighted only if it beats naive3P5
engine/discover.pyTitle phrases go to a review listP6
Re-plan job (new)Compare top 3 match_roles day over dayP7

frontend/data.js is an offline copy. It can show stale numbers when the API fails, so always show its date.

5

What could go wrong, and how is it handled?

RiskMitigation
HN gives one thread a month, so daily moves are small, and early-month counts are noisyNowcast weights the partial month by post count; show posts so far
HN Algolia outage or rate limitKeep last good snapshot; retry next day
Posts edited or deleted after fetch change countsRe-fetch the current thread daily until the month closes, then freeze
Ephemeral disk on Replit AutoscaleWrite only through the store, never to data/
Two schedulers write at once (15-min pipeline and daily refresh)One lock, run_pipeline_if_idle pattern
Daily band re-fit makes labels flip-flop and sends noisy alertsHysteresis: alert only if a change holds for two runs or crosses a label
Look-ahead leak from nowcast and lead featuresExtend the scramble-future test to cover them
Fast scenario k is estimated on skills, untested on rolesLabel it an estimate; backtest at role level
Changing future_score reorders rankings and breaks tests that expect 1, 0.5 and 0Update tests/test_roles.py in the same change; compare rankings for saved users
Role profiles need raw historyKeep them on a fixed schedule, not daily
Malaysian scraping: robots.txt changes, bot challenges, layout changes, PDPAKeep robots check and rate limits in my_jobs.py; strip PII; evidence only until 12 months of history
Persona LLM panel: cost, hallucinationAbout $1 a month; declare it; evidence only, logged to the ledger
frontend/data.js shows stale numbers if the API failsAlways show its date
